text.offer: Pietro says, "Past the Lake of Jala's Song, in the Cragged Mountains, there's a place older than any town. Nobody knows who built it. The way down to Brax starts there, and so does a mana node, if you can keep your head while the sky throws lightning at you."
text.progress: From Jasper: East Jasper, the Lake of Jala's Song, the Cragged Mountains, and then An ancient place, its origin forgotten.
text.complete: Hair standing on end? That'll be the node. Or the lightning.

steps.objective: Bond with the node in the ancient place
